verdicts.reason: The two candidates are practically the same. Both turn the design into a left-to-right leaderboard with a readable headline and a clear pink CTA. In both, the FIZZBANG! logo pill is jammed against the cropped pop-art shapes and sits on top of the yellow stripe, so the logo is crowded and the artwork has a busy collision behind it. In both, the geometric art is cut down to a cramped sliver at the left edge, a thin blue strip at the right edge looks accidental, and the CTA text is small, so the pop-art feel of the original is mostly lost.
